name: Cherry Tomato 'Sweet Bite'
description: Compact cherry tomato that sets long trusses of small sweet fruit all summer. A forgiving choice for a first vegetable garden or a sunny balcony.
soil_type: Rich, well-drained loam with plenty of organic matter
sowing_method: Start indoors 6-8 weeks before last frost. Transplant after all danger of frost has passed.

name: Paste Tomato 'Old Italian'
description: Meaty heirloom plum tomato with few seeds, grown for sauces. Needs staking, regular pruning and steady watering to avoid blossom end rot.
sowing_method: Start indoors 6-8 weeks before last frost. Harden off and transplant into warm soil.
disease_resistance: Limited disease resistance typical of heirlooms
common_diseases: Late blight, early blight, blossom end rot

name: Sweet Bell Pepper 'Garden Block'
description: Thick-walled blocky bell pepper that ripens from green to red. Likes heat and a long warm season.
water_requirement: 1-1.5 inches per week, keep evenly moist
soil_type: Well-drained sandy loam rich in organic matter
sowing_method: Start indoors 8-10 weeks before last frost. Transplant when soil is consistently warm.

name: Hot Pepper 'Little Flame'
description: Small bushy hot pepper covered in upright red fruit. Drought tolerant once established and happy in a pot.
water_requirement: 1 inch per week, drought tolerant once established
soil_type: Well-drained sandy loam, tolerates poor soils
sowing_method: Start indoors 8-10 weeks before last frost.
flavor_profile: Hot with a clean sharp heat
culinary_uses: Hot sauces, drying for flakes, pickling

name: Butterhead Lettuce 'Soft Heart'
description: Loose buttery heads ready in a few weeks. Grows best in cool weather and tolerates partial shade, which slows bolting.
sun_requirement: Full sun to partial shade (4-6 hours)
water_requirement: High — consistent moisture needed, shallow roots
sowing_method: Direct sow outdoors in early spring or late summer. Sow every two weeks for a steady harvest.

name: Cut-and-Come-Again Leaf Mix
description: Blend of red and green loose-leaf lettuces harvested leaf by leaf. One of the fastest crops for beginners, even in a window box.
sun_requirement: Partial shade to full sun (3-6 hours)
water_requirement: 1 inch per week, keep soil evenly moist
sowing_method: Direct sow outdoors as soon as soil can be worked. Scatter seeds and cover lightly.

name: Sweet Basil 'Large Leaf'
description: Classic fragrant basil with large tender leaves. Loves warmth and sun, hates cold nights; pinch the tips to keep it bushy.
water_requirement: 1 inch per week, do not let it dry out
sowing_method: Start indoors 4-6 weeks before last frost or direct sow once soil is warm.

name: Spearmint
description: Vigorous spreading perennial with refreshing leaves. Almost impossible to kill and best kept in a container so it does not take over the bed.
sun_requirement: Full sun to partial shade (4-6 hours)
sowing_method: Plant divisions or cuttings in spring. Seeds are slow and variable.

name: Rosemary 'Upright Blue'
description: Woody evergreen shrub with needle-like aromatic leaves. Thrives on neglect in dry, poor, sandy soil and full sun.
sowing_method: Start from cuttings or nursery plants. Seeds germinate slowly and unevenly.
common_diseases: Root rot in wet soil, powdery mildew

name: Radish 'Quick Red'
description: Crisp round radish ready about four weeks after sowing. The classic first crop for children and beginners.
sun_requirement: Full sun to partial shade (4-6+ hours)
water_requirement: 1 inch per week, keep evenly moist
sowing_method: Direct sow outdoors in early spring and again in fall. Thin seedlings early.

name: Carrot 'Sweet Finger'
description: Cylindrical blunt-tipped carrot with sweet orange roots. Needs deep, loose, stone-free soil and patience during slow germination.
water_requirement: 1 inch per week, steady moisture during germination
soil_type: Deep, loose, sandy loam free of stones
sowing_method: Direct sow outdoors 2-3 weeks before last frost. Do not transplant.

name: Bush Bean 'Garden Green'
description: Compact bush bean that needs no support and crops heavily over a few weeks. Fixes its own nitrogen and grows in average soil.
water_requirement: 1 inch per week, more during flowering
sowing_method: Direct sow outdoors after last frost when soil is warm. Beans dislike transplanting.

name: Slicing Cucumber 'Cool Crunch'
description: Productive vining cucumber with smooth dark fruit. Thirsty and hungry plant that climbs a trellis to save space.
water_requirement: High — 1-2 inches per week, consistent moisture needed
sowing_method: Direct sow after last frost or start indoors 3 weeks earlier in biodegradable pots.
disease_resistance: Resistant to powdery mildew and cucumber mosaic virus

name: Zucchini 'Summer Green'
description: Bushy summer squash famous for giving more fruit than a family can eat. Pick young for the best texture.
soil_type: Rich, well-drained soil with plenty of organic matter
sowing_method: Direct sow outdoors after last frost in warm soil.

name: Garlic 'Purple Stripe'
description: Hardneck garlic planted in fall and harvested the following summer. Nearly trouble-free and stores for months.
water_requirement: Low to moderate — stop watering before harvest
sowing_method: Plant individual cloves outdoors in fall, pointed end up, 2 inches deep.
flavor_profile: Strong and spicy, mellow when roasted

name: Chives
description: Clump-forming perennial with mild onion-flavored leaves and edible purple flowers. Comes back every year with almost no care.
sun_requirement: Full sun to partial shade (4-6 hours)
sowing_method: Direct sow outdoors in spring or divide existing clumps.

name: Strawberry 'Everbearing Red'
description: Everbearing strawberry that fruits from early summer to fall. Works in hanging baskets and pots; replace plants every three years.
water_requirement: 1-2 inches per week, consistent moisture needed
sowing_method: Plant bare-root crowns or plugs in early spring with the crown at soil level.

name: Marigold 'Little Sun'
description: Cheerful compact annual with orange and yellow blooms until frost. Often planted next to vegetables and thrives in poor soil.
water_requirement: Low to moderate — tolerates dry spells
soil_type: Average, well-drained soil, tolerates poor soils
sowing_method: Direct sow outdoors after last frost or start indoors 4-6 weeks earlier.
culinary_uses: Edible petals as garnish, companion planting

name: Aloe Vera
description: Fleshy rosette that stores water in thick leaves. Needs very little watering and bright light; overwatering is the main way to kill it.
sun_requirement: Full sun to partial shade (4-6 hours)
water_requirement: Low — drought tolerant, let soil dry completely between waterings
soil_type: Sandy, gritty, very well-drained cactus mix
sowing_method: Propagate from offsets (pups) removed from the mother plant.
